patterns.note: Content is presented in a centered, fixed-width column with generous horizontal padding, ensuring readability and focus on the main information.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text for descriptions and details.
The design uses a stark white background with dark grey text, punctuated by a single vibrant purple/blue accent color for all primary calls-to-action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page remains fixed to the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation and key actions.
Feature lists and download options are consistently presented in a three-column grid layout, each item featuring an icon, a concise title, and a brief descriptive text.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that maintains its full height and background color as the user scrolls, ensuring navigation is always visible and accessible.
Structure content within a fixed-width container, horizontally centered, with ample vertical spacing between sections to create an airy and uncluttered layout.
Use a single, bright accent color for all primary call-to-action buttons and interactive elements, making them visually distinct against a neutral background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) for section titles, with smaller, legible body text and even smaller, subtle labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons, download tags, and the prominent code editor screenshot.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and balanced, comfortable spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extremely clean and functional aesthetic, prioritizing clarity and directness. The prominent, high-fidelity code editor screenshot serves as the hero visual, immediately communicating the product's core utility without relying on abstract imagery or heavy graphics.
